Project Objectives
1. Soil Binder Pilot: Piloting cost-effective, and resilience-building and an eco-friendly soil binder in improving soil stability and preventing erosion on embankments, homesteads, and rural roads in cyclone-prone coastal regions.
2. Ella Pad Pilot: To promote menstrual hygiene management among schoolgirls through distribution of biodegradable pads and awareness sessions, while strengthening community-based women’s enterprises producing eco-friendly pads.

The coastal belt of Bangladesh, home to over 35 million people, faces growing challenges due to soil erosion, salinity intrusion, and tidal flooding. Recurrent cyclones, tidal surges, and sea-level rise continue to degrade land, damage infrastructure, and threaten livelihoods. Traditional methods such as earthen embankments and sandbagging have proven short-lived and require constant maintenance.
To address these vulnerabilities, Cordaid proposes piloting Soil Binder technology an environmentally friendly, climate-resilient solution developed by Dutch Agro to strengthen soil stability and reduce erosion in coastal areas such as Satkhira, Khulna, and Bagerhat. Simultaneously, recognizing the urgent need for menstrual health and eco-friendly waste management, Cordaid aims to pilot Ella Pad, a biodegradable sanitary pad made from water hyacinth and other natural fibers, supporting adolescent girls’ health and promoting sustainable livelihoods for women.
